## Highlights

- Temporary provider-capacity refusals no longer trip the hourly automated-start circuit. Fleet Manager keeps dispatching through short OpenAI capacity pressure, while each fresh delegated or scheduled start still observes the provider's one-minute retry floor before trying again ([#4985](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4985), [#4945](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/issues/4945)). Real automated starts continue to count toward the circuit, so repeated task failures still receive the existing protection.

## Upgrade notes

- From v0.5.90 to v0.5.91 no database migration or configuration change is needed, and the API contract stays at `3.44.0`. The fleet scheduler adopts the retry behavior on its next run after the backend is upgraded; no manual task or schedule changes are required.
